purpose: 仅概念预览，不作为游戏实现
prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished 16:9 desktop game interface concept at 1920x1080 or larger. This is a design preview, NOT an actual captured game screenshot. Input 1 is the user's authoritative art direction: preserve the appealing original stylized 3D coastal kart racing world, cyan sea and sky, warm natural sunlight, lush grass and flowers, faceted green and pink trees, wooden guardrails, lighthouse and small coastal houses, red-white curbs, textured asphalt. Keep compact original toy-like helmeted drivers and karts. Input 2 is the authoritative KART CLUB logo silhouette: use exactly that silhouette as a flat luminous lime #C0FA67 mark, including its transparent road cutout and five checker cutouts. Remove the large dark green logo embedded in input 1. Do not invent a different logo. UI palette: off-white typography, translucent dark teal #132C30 backgrounds only underneath UI for legibility, #C0FA67 for main action and selected states. Crisp Chinese sans-serif text, condensed sporty numerical typography. Sophisticated clean racing game client UI, moderate 10-14px corner radius, fine borders, little ornamentation. Do not darken or blur the whole scene. No neon sci-fi, no chrome rainbow, no fake web browser frame, no phone, no tilted device, no additional logo or watermark. Chinese text must be readable and exact. Keep about 64px safe margin.
Asset type: Main game lobby concept. Recompose the reference coastal world with a parked lime kart and friendly helmeted driver shown at large readable three-quarter angle on the RIGHT foreground of the track. The beautiful seafront circuit sweeps behind toward the lighthouse. Clear inviting warm daylight, clean physically plausible stylized materials and tire contact shadows; keep a real-time-game visual ambition, not a photographic landscape.
UI composition: top navigation across screen: lime silhouette logo at top left 42px beside text "KART CLUB"; navigation labels "赛事大厅" (active lime underline), "单人挑战", "多人联机", "奖励金库"; small balance badge at top right "1,000 PONS" with tiny label "模拟余额", then an understated settings gear.
LEFT side main lobby menu occupies at most 32% width on a dark-teal transparent panel with generous padding. Exact title "赛事大厅" and smaller description "选择玩法，即刻开跑". A 2x2 group of compact mode buttons with exact labels "竞速赛", "道具赛", "计时赛", "自由练习"; "竞速赛" selected. Under this, a slim current circuit row with small coastline preview and exact text "晴湾海岸" and subtext "3 圈 · 7 名 AI". Primary wide lime button "开始比赛 →", secondary restrained button "与好友竞速". Small note under actions "单人模式免费".
At very bottom left in small quiet white text "晴湾海岸 · 浪潮 MK I". Preserve broad clear view of the kart and landscape. No oversized marketing headline, no fake shop, no car stats that are not specified, no rewards floating in center, no list of tasks, no crowded promotional cards. This should look like an elegant playable racing game's main menu with a three-dimensional world behind it.

Center top an understated slim dark translucent capsule "晴湾海岸" with "圈数 2 / 3". Upper right a compact time plate label "比赛时间" with readable "00:48.36", then a separate small pause icon. Avoid an opaque bar across whole top.
